messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — seeing weird SSE behavior in python-sdk 0.4.2. Connection closes immediately after a 'data: [DONE]' chunk and the client emits EOF then on reconnect we sometimes get a duplicate final token. Anyone else run into this?

sam: Which endpoint & minimal repro? :thinking: 

maria: Streaming responses from /v1/chat/stream. Repro steps:

```
# curl repro
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/chat/stream?model=test" -o -
```

Logs (raw chunks):

```
data: {"id":"r1","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hel"}}]}

data: {"id":"r1","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"lo"}}]}

data: [DONE]

```

Client receives socket EOF right after the `[DONE]` and treats buffer as truncated, so on reconnect we get the final 'lo' again (duplicate). I think parser doesn't treat EOF as a boundary in some cases.

lee: Could be CRLF/LF normalization or the parser looking for `\\n\\n` specifically. Can you paste the exact bytes (hexdump) if possible?

maria: here's the hex-ish dump (simplified):

```
64 61 74 61 3a 20 7b 22 69 64 22 3a 22 72 31 22 2c 22 63 68 6f 69 63 65 73 22 3a 5b 7b 22 64 65 6c 74 61 22 3a 7b 22 63 6f 6e 74 65 6e 74 22 3a 22 48 65 6c 22 7d 7d 5d 7d 0a 0a
64 61 74 61 3a 20 5b 44 4f 4e 45 5d 0a 0a
<FIN>
```

alex: I dug into the python-sdk SSE reader — it's using a buffered readline loop and an `on_close` that only checks for `if buf.endswith("\\\n\\\n")` before emitting. If the server sends `\\n\\n` but the socket close arrives in a separate event the buffer sometimes ends with single `\\n` and gets dropped. Proposed fix:

```
# pseudo-patch
if closed:
    # treat EOF as event delimiter
    buf += "\\\n\\\n"
process_events(buf)
```

sam: Nice catch. Can you open a PR with tests that simulate split TCP segments?

maria: PR opened: #3245 — includes a unit test that simulates chunk boundaries split across recv calls. Patch fixes the duplicate-final-token for me locally :tada:

deploy-bot: PR #3245 merged to main by alex — changelog: fix(sdk): treat EOF as SSE event boundary to avoid duplicate final tokens on reconnect

maria: Verified in staging — streaming looks clean now. Thanks all :heart:
